capabilities.justification: OpenBackend.readFile reads caller-authorized paths after the manifest check.
OpenBackend.writeFile writes caller-authorized paths after the manifest check.
OpenBackend.createFile exclusively creates caller-authorized paths after the manifest check.
OpenBackend.deleteFile deletes caller-authorized paths after the manifest check.
OpenBackend.listDir lists caller-authorized directories after the manifest check.
OpenBackend.readEnv looks up caller-authorized variable names in the process environment.

justification: Slice 2 adds the audit envelopes (pure data) and the Backend seam. OpenBackend performs caller-authorized filesystem and environment reads after the manifest check (enforcement in slice-3 secure wrappers); its unit tests exercise only isolated temp directories plus a PATH lookup. env:write is deliberately NOT declared: OpenBackend.writeEnv always throws UnsupportedError because dart:io exposes the process environment read-only, and TestBackend.writeEnv is in-memory recording with no OS effect. This manifest is intentionally NOT read/write-separation clean (fs read+write over '*'): the cage is the enforcement mechanism, and separation is enforced per caller manifest at each wrapped call, not on the mechanism's own surface.
